description: Three multiplexers on one panel, two of them choosing between two inputs and one choosing between four

inputs.text: Reaches that switch's output while its select input reads 0V or below
Reaches that switch's output while its select input reads above 0V
Chooses between that switch's two inputs: above 0V takes the second, 0V or below takes the first
One of the four inputs of the four-way multiplexer, counted from the top starting at zero, reaching the output when the select voltage rounds to its number
Chooses which of the four inputs reaches the output: the voltage is made positive and rounded to a whole number, 0 taking the first and anything above 3 taking the last

outputs.text: Carries whichever of that switch's two inputs is selected
Carries whichever of the four inputs is selected

notes: the two-way switches read their select jack as a level with no threshold beyond zero, so a negative voltage selects the first input, which is also what an unpatched jack does
